meta.name: executive-onboarding-playbook
meta.description: Plan a VP or CPO 30-60-90 day diagnostic onboarding path. Use when entering a new executive product role and avoiding premature change.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划高管入职诊断路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚担任产品高管，需要系统化入职计划
copy.tagline_en: Plan an executive onboarding diagnostic path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are entering a new executive product role and need a structured onboarding plan

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按诊断、验证、有据行动三个阶段规划入职前90天，帮你收集证据、避免过早行动。
howto.when: 当你开始新的VP或CPO产品领导角色，或评估相关offer时触发。

say.text: 我刚接受了一个VP of Product的职位，帮我规划前90天。
我在评估一个CPO offer，该问CEO什么问题？
我入职两个月了，想验证一下我的发现再行动。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a three-phase diagnostic onboarding plan (Diagnose, Validate, Act with Evidence) for your first 90 days as a VP or CPO, helping you collect evidence and avoid premature changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a new VP or CPO product role, or when evaluating a CPO offer.

say_en.text: I just accepted a VP of Product role starting next month—help me plan my first 90 days.
I'm evaluating a CPO offer and want to know what questions to ask the hiring CEO.
I'm two months into a new role and want to validate what I've learned before I start acting.
